knowledge_point.title: Describing an Entry of a Matrix in Index Notation

question.:question/problem:
Consider the highlighted entry of the matrix $X$ given below. Describe it in terms of $x_{ij}$.

$X = \begin{bmatrix}0 & 6 & -3 & 6 \\ 7 & -4 & 7 & 7 \\ -2 & -9 & -9 & \boxed{2}\end{bmatrix}$
question.:question/worked-solution: The entry lies at the intersection of the $3$rd row and $4$th column. Hence, we have $x_{34}=2.$
